An '''utuku tree''' is a tree found only in [[Daemonheim]]. It requires 30 [[Woodcutting]] to be chopped down and can yield 1-9 [[Utuku branches]] before depletion. Each log cut gives 115 Woodcutting experience. High [[complexity]] is required to find this tree whilst Dungeoneering.
